diagramManager.storageServerNote: Diagrams are saved on the server and available across all devices
diagramManager.storageLocalFilesNote: Diagrams are saved as files in your Documents/ArchFlow folder

alert.quotaExceeded: Storage quota exceeded. Please export important diagrams and clear some space.

auth.sessionExpired: Your session has ended. Log in again to keep working; your diagram stays open.
auth.forgotHint: Forgot your password? Ask your ArchFlow administrator to reset it.
auth.setupIntro: This ArchFlow has no accounts yet. The first account is the administrator, who can then add other people.
auth.name: Name
auth.mustChangeIntro: You logged in as {{email}} with a temporary password. Choose your own password to continue.
auth.guestNote: Guest: saving only in this browser or to a file

account.title: Account
account.passwordChanged: Password changed. Other browsers have been logged out.
account.tokensTitle: Tokens for AI assistants and the API
account.tokensIntro: A token lets an AI assistant (MCP) or a script use ArchFlow as you, with your rights. Make a separate token for each place you use it.
account.noApiAccess: API and MCP access isn't turned on for your account. Ask the administrator.
account.tokenOnce: Copy it now: it won't be shown again. If you lose it, create a new one.
account.claudeCodeHint: To connect Claude Code, run in a terminal:
account.revokeConfirm: Revoke the token "{{name}}"? Whatever uses it will stop working.

admin.title: Users and settings
admin.temporaryPasswordHint: Give it to the person. They'll set their own password when they first log in. It won't be shown again.
admin.deleteConfirm: Delete {{email}}? Their tokens are deleted too; their diagrams stay.
admin.publicAccessHint: People who aren't logged in can open ArchFlow and design, but save only in their browser or to a file, never to the server.
admin.apiAccessForAll: API and MCP access for everyone
admin.apiAccessForAllHint: Every user may create tokens for AI assistants and scripts. Otherwise only administrators and the users you choose.
admin.noTokens: Nobody has created a token yet.

errors.tooMany: Too many failed attempts. Try again in 15 minutes.
errors.passwordShort: The password must have at least 8 characters
errors.exists: A user with this e-mail already exists
errors.lastAdmin: ArchFlow needs at least one active administrator
errors.self: You can't disable, demote or delete your own account
errors.noApi: API and MCP access isn't turned on for your account

share.title: Share “{{name}}”
share.teamHint: Everyone logged in sees it; editors can change it.
share.privateHint: Only you, administrators and the people below.
share.peopleHintPrivate: They see it even though it's private; with “Can edit” they can also change it.
share.peopleHintTeam: The whole team sees it anyway. People added here keep access if you make it private later.
share.linksHint: Anyone with a link can view the diagram, without logging in. A link can't change anything.
share.linkOnce: Copy it now: it won't be shown again. Revoke it below when it's no longer needed.
share.linkFailed: This link doesn't work. It may have expired or been revoked.
